verdict.rationale: Cekura is a testing and observability platform for voice agents, and such platforms can plausibly offer prompt management, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only A/B comparison of agent versions to measure prompt changes. Nothing documents Cekura storing or versioning prompts, or deploying prompt changes to production without a code release.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code
